entry.title: the new eponym (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the new eponym (pictured) of Fort Bragg stole a German ambulance and drove 20 miles (32 km) under fire to save a wounded soldier during the Battle of the Bulge?

entry.content: ... that the political and media storm around so-called African gangs in Australia has been described by academics as a moral panic?
